title: answer_only
goal: Submit the requested final fields without rewriting correct results
guidance: Submit only the requested final answer fields, never reasoning, labels, intermediate operands or alternative answers. Default numeric output is the number alone: asking what percent does not itself request a % suffix. An explicit template, literal % example, requested suffix or list takes priority. Rounding precision alone does not require padding zeros; omit redundant decimal zeros unless a fixed-width format is explicit. Preserve sign and scale. Submit the final acquired calculation without recomputing it in prose.

title: arc_change
goal: Distinguish arc change from ordinary growth
guidance: Arc or symmetric percentage change uses (new-old)/((old+new)/2), not (new-old)/old. Take abs only if requested; convert the fraction to percent only when requested, multiplying by 100 once. This endpoint change is not annualized and does not divide by the number of years. If an elasticity specifies a second changing quantity, divide by that quantity's midpoint change. Compute with unrounded operands and format only at submission.

title: percent_difference
goal: Distinguish symmetric percent difference from directional growth
guidance: An absolute percent difference between two amounts uses abs(b-a)/((a+b)/2)*100 when no reference baseline is specified. A percent change relative to a named baseline instead divides by that baseline. Do not substitute one formula for the other. Keep source units equal, calculate at full precision, then round and submit only the requested result.

title: median_absolute_deviation
goal: Use the median rather than mean for explicitly defined MAD
guidance: When MAD is defined as median absolute deviation, first m=median(values), then MAD=median(abs(x-m)). It is not mean(abs(x-m)). Keep the exact requested observation periods, units and revisions; calculate any subsequent difference against the named benchmark only after MAD is computed.

title: table_block_binding
goal: Keep extracted observations inside their named table and row type
guidance: Bind each value to table title, row label, full column header, unit and period. End extraction at the next table heading. Never scan a fixed character chunk across tables or let another same-year row overwrite an annual total. Separate annual, monthly, fiscal-to-date and estimate rows. Where receipts/outlays are present, check total surplus=total receipts-total outlays before fitting.

title: log_growth_cv
goal: Calculate coefficient of variation of log growth rates
when: coefficient of variation.*log growth|growth-based Debt Sustainability
guidance: For levels x[0..n], form consecutive g[i]=ln(x[i+1]/x[i]); CV=population_std(g)/mean(g) when population is requested. Compute both series at full precision, then abs(CV1-CV2); round once. Use Python for the complete operation, especially when mean growth is near zero. Failed execution supplies no computed value.

title: complete_monthly_series
goal: Compute a complete monthly mean or argmax
guidance: Build explicit (year,month,series1,series2) records from the table's year groups. Require exactly one record for every requested month before computing spread=series1-series2. Use Python for mean or argmax over all records; do not average a convenient panel or estimate from visual peaks. Keep the winning year/month with argmax, then apply any requested encoding arithmetically.

title: month_encoding
goal: Apply a requested arithmetic date encoding
guidance: After finding the requested month and year, compute the stated arithmetic expression explicitly. For month*100+year, do that addition; do not concatenate YYYYMM or use year*100+month. Submit the calculated integer only.

title: category_aggregation
goal: Count named categories after merging their subcolumns
guidance: The question's named categories are the counting units. Combine life and fire/casualty insurance into insurance companies, and general plus pension funds into state/local governments when those are the named parent categories. Sum all in-scope instrument rows per category before applying the threshold. Do not count total outstanding or all-other-investors as a requested category.

title: ffo_public_layout
source_basis: Public FFO-1 headers and row types in the supplied Treasury Bulletin pages; no target answers.
guidance: FFO-1 fact card: receipts, outlays and surplus/deficit each have total/on-budget/off-budget columns. Annual fiscal-year rows and later fiscal-to-date/monthly rows can repeat the same year. Select the total surplus/deficit of the annual row, inside FFO-1; retain its header and row evidence. A repeated year later in the page is not automatically a revised annual value.

title: ay1_public_layout
goal: Recognize repeated year panels in the bond yield table
source_basis: Public AY-1 table headers, repeated Jan-Dec bands and weekly-date overlap in supplied pages; no target answers.
guidance: AY-1 fact card: monthly rows repeat Jan-Dec in stacked year bands and horizontal groups of Treasury/Aa-corporate/municipal columns. OCR may omit the year labels. Verify group years using visible labels and dated weekly overlap; the partially populated last band is not a complete earlier year. Keep blank cells and footnote markers from shifting numeric columns.
